media.title: Prepare images
media.lead: Pick images; they are compressed and converted to WebP in the browser. Add the files to the images folder and paste the path into your post.
media.dropTitle: Click to choose images or drop files here
media.dropHint: PNG · JPG · WebP · GIF · up to 10 MB per file
media.pathHint: Path format to use in a post:
media.tip1: 16:9 or 21:9 works best for cover images.
media.tip2: Images above 2 MB slow the page down; quality around 80 is enough.
media.tip3: Keep file names free of non-Latin characters.

about.title: What is {site}?
about.lead: An archive of apps, games and software worth your time — fast, ad-free and always up to date.
about.approachText: Every post is a JavaScript file; pages read them in the browser and build themselves. No database, no server code — just fast, cheap and easy-to-maintain pages.
about.what1: App reviews, release notes and download guides
about.what2: Game reviews, mods and installation walkthroughs
about.techText: HTML, CSS and JavaScript. CKEditor 5 for writing, Fancybox for galleries, Disqus for comments. Every library is served locally — no CDN.
about.contribText: Use the publishing studio to submit a post or report a fix, or reach us through the contact channels.
about.principlesText: Only verifiable information, open links and readable text. No ads, no tracking scripts.

privacy.title: Privacy & cookies
privacy.lead: This site is static: we have no server of our own, no database and no user accounts.
privacy.d1: Studio drafts: kept only in your browser's local storage; never sent to a server. Cleared when you clear browser data.
privacy.d2: Theme and language preference: also stored only in your browser.
privacy.d3: Comments: the comment area is provided by Disqus. When you post a comment, the related data goes to Disqus; Disqus' privacy policy applies.
privacy.p2: This site sets no cookies of its own. Only the third-party comment service may use cookies, required for the comment session.
privacy.p3: Posts may contain third-party download links. Those sites are responsible for their own content and policies.
privacy.p4: For privacy questions use the comment area or the site administrator's contact channels.
privacy.note: This is sample privacy text; update it to your own situation before going live.
